'''October 2001 Melbourne tournament (29 October)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Adam Amy's house, Melbourne, Australia on 29 October 2001. [[Luca Costanzo]] won it. It is known from Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3087">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-29-melbourne-oz-30-10-01d3087/ melbourne-oz-30-10-01], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 29 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-29-melbourne-oz-30-10-01d3087/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Adam Amy's house, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Luca Costanzo]]
